title: Living in Dawson Ranch & Regatta Oaks | Belton TX Neighborhood Tour & Home Prices (2025 Update)
description:

In this episode, we’re diving into two of Belton’s most desirable neighborhoods — Dawson Ranch and Regatta Oaks. From average home prices and lot sizes to local schools and community amenities, we’re breaking down everything you need to know about living here in Central Texas.

These neighborhoods are known for their quiet streets, mature trees, and proximity to Belton Lake, all while keeping you close to Belton ISD schools, shopping, and restaurants. Whether you’re relocating to the area or just curious about life in Belton, this video gives you the full picture.
